name: Mindcraft
description: LLM-driven Minecraft bots that join your world, chat with players and carry out tasks by writing and running code.
whatItDoes: Spawns AI players in Minecraft Java Edition that gather, build, fight and collaborate on instruction. It is used for play and for research on embodied agents.
howItWorks: A Node.js process connects bots through Mineflayer to a world opened to LAN and prompts an LLM for commands or generated JavaScript. Because bots can execute generated code, the README advises caution and offers a Docker option.

requirements.name: Minecraft Java Edition
requirements.description: A supported game version with the world opened to LAN

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: Placed in keys.json; OpenAI by default, or local models through Ollama

models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama and many others
